newsitem.title: USA: Intl Murex to post 1996 profit.
newsitem.headline: Intl Murex to post 1996 profit.

text.p: International Murex Technologies Corp said Tuesday it would report a profit for the full year 1996 after returning to profitability in the third quarter.
The company said in a release that in 1996 it settled its four-year Hepatitis C litigation with Chiron Corp and entered the emerging diagnostics monitoring market.
International Murex said it will "experience rapid revenue growth" as new products are introduced into the diagnostics monitoring market, which is expected to exceed $1 billion by the year 2000.
